components.name: Quiet Button

components.name: Card
components.description: Calm 20px rounded container with soft ambient shadow.
components.html:
Your devices

Manage seats and backups from your Tuned account.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 14px rounded field with 3:1 edge against the card.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font: 600 0.9rem/1.4 Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1B1A21; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 6px; min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 16px; font: 400 16px/1.5 Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1B1A21; background: #F0ECF6; border: 1px solid #79757F; border-radius: 14px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #5A35F0; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5A35F0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Brand Nav
components.description: Channel stack + Tuned name; website brand row.
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #1B1A21; text-decoration: none; font: 700 1.25rem/1 Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5A35F0; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-brand-mark { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 11px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #26213A, #0B0A10); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(11,10,16,0.35); } .ds-brand-mark span { position: absolute; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-brand-mark span:nth-child(1) { left: 8px; top: 14px; background: #6D4AFF; transform: rotate(-18deg); } .ds-brand-mark span:nth-child(2) { left: 13px; top: 13px; background: #00C2A8; transform: rotate(-6deg); } .ds-brand-mark span:nth-child(3) { left: 18px; top: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill chip for browse filters; selected uses primary soft.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #CAC4D0; background: #F0ECF6; color: #1B1A21; font: 600 0.9rem/1 Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-selected { background: #E6DEFF; color: #1C0A66; border-color: transparent; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #5A35F0; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Tuned is designed for someone on the couch with a D-pad (and often a phone nearby): browse channels and titles quickly, start watching, and forget the chrome. The interface is quiet and fast — cache-first, video-first — and dark-room confident when the lights are down. Accent colour is sparing; the picture and the programme are the heroes.

The system is Material 3 throughout the Android app, with Tuned’s violet/teal brand expressed through colour roles, soft rounded shapes, and pill buttons. The companion website mirrors that same language (`devices/public/site.css`) so account and marketing surfaces feel like the app, not a separate product. Soft lavender paper in light mode and living-room ink in dark mode keep surfaces calm; a soft violet glow at the top of web pages is atmosphere, not decoration for its own sake.

Visual anti-references (confirmed): no loud IPTV clutter; no second video inset or multi-view chrome; no full-bleed / edge-to-edge pop-ups.
keyCharacteristics: Living-room remote first (TV D-pad), phone as peer
Material 3 structure; brand in colour, shape, and focus

rules.name: The Sparing Accent Rule
rules.body: Primary violet/teal marks focus, primary actions, and brand moments — never wallpaper a whole browse screen in brand colour. Video and posters own the pixels.

rules.name: The Contrast-Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Accent and status colours must stay ≥4.5:1 on every surface/card in light, dark, and pure black (ThemeContrastTest). A new accent that fails does not ship.

rules.name: The System Face Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a display webfont or custom typeface for product UI. Brand lives in colour and the channel-stack mark, not in a novelty font.

rules.name: The Grow-With-Settings Rule
rules.body: Type is in sp / relative sizes so system font scale works; text containers use minimum heights, never fixed heights that clip large text.

rules.name: The Overscan Rule
rules.body: On TV, interactive content stays inside TvSafeArea; only intentional backdrops bleed.

rules.name: The Centred Dialog Rule
rules.body: Pop-ups never stretch edge-to-edge; they sit centred with edge margin.

rules.name: The Flat-App Rule
rules.body: Do not invent Compose drop shadows for ordinary lists and settings; use surface containers.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: The violet page glow is background mood only — never a substitute for hierarchy or focus.

rules.name: The Pill Button Rule
rules.body: Primary and quiet buttons are fully round; do not square them off for “dashboard” fashion.

dos: Do keep the UI quiet so browsing and watching feel effortless — chrome yields to video and posters.
Do use Material 3 roles and TunedShapes; express brand through violet/teal, the channel-stack mark, and focus rings.
Do keep dialogs centred with ≥24 dp edge margin and ≤560 dp (≤720 dp only for TV code dialogs).
Do honour TV overscan margins and bleed backdrops intentionally.
Do meet contrast in every theme/accent; give colour-only state a text/semantics twin.
Do match website surfaces to the app via site.css tokens (except admin, which keeps its own look).
donts: Don't build loud IPTV clutter (neon overload, dense ornamental chrome, competing status jewellery).
Don't add a second video inset, multi-view, or live preview chrome — one stream only.
Don't ship full-bleed / edge-to-edge pop-ups for ordinary dialogs.
Don't replace Roboto with a novelty display face or load third-party webfonts on the product site.
Don't put player tools behind a three-dot menu — top-row buttons only.
Don't invent Compose drop shadows where tonal surfaces already carry depth.
